workload.note: Suffered a major/torn ACL injury in November 2025 during his final college season at Louisville; no 2026 NFL workload yet (rookie, has not practiced with team due to injury)

contract.note: Rookie contract; drafted in the 3rd round, No. 94 overall, in the 2026 NFL Draft by Miami

scheme.note: Dolphins hired new HC Jeff Hafley (formerly Packers DC) in the 2026 offseason; Bobby Slowik (formerly Houston Texans OC) was promoted/hired as Dolphins offensive coordinator under Hafley, per AP/nbcmiami/cbsnews reports and Feb 4, 2026 introductory press conference.

notes: Bell was placed on the Active/Non-Football Injury (NFI) list around July 21, 2026 (dolphinseer.wordpress.com, nbcsports.com/profootballtalk) because his ACL tear occurred in college (Nov 2025), not with the Dolphins -- some outlets (playerprofiler.com) colloquially call this 'PUP,' but the technical designation reported by nbcsports/AP is NFI, not PUP (Physically Unable to Perform is normally for injuries sustained with the current team)
si.com/onsi (Aug 4, 2026) reports he may be moved to Reserve/NFI before the Aug 30 53-man roster cutdown, which would sideline him for at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season
Draft-profile comparisons made to A.J. Brown regarding skill set/physique (si.com/onsi)
